scope: Recursive stable array element contracts for ordinary bindings and corresponding static bounds.

analysisLatency.method: Identical harness including array fixture, 5 warmups and 20 measured parse-plus-analysis samples per fixture. Separate sequential baseline and changed runs on the same machine. Other tests were active; indicative only, not a speedup claim.

demoCompatibility.notes: Direct Interpreter comparison without a module/file host; excludes non-test Euler mains. Full interpreter type corpus covers additional programs. The CLI graph test run supplies the real host: 36 test files, zero failures.
demoCompatibility.hostTestResult: Initial complete CLI run found 14 contract-related failures in six demo files; all passed after migrations in focused reruns (55 Deep-ML files and the forest-query file). Three additional failures passed after copying the existing ignored Africa CSV fixture from the main checkout. Kaggle source migrations were applied before the full run and passed there.

notes: Corpus result coverage is unchanged at 1083 of 1085 examples. New focused tests verify retained element bounds across writes and recursive mismatch diagnostics.
Contracts do not establish purity, read safety, exact lengths or concrete values.
Infinity seeds retain a sentinel alternative while the first finite domain settles to integer or real.
Ten demo programs migrated: distinct names for integer-to-real normalization, real accumulators/features, and materialized prefix-sum cells.
